decision: Independent UI rewrite except existing native Liquid Glass effect and upstream execution/signing engines

protected_runtime.description: Keep existing native Liquid Glass implementation and touch/gesture material; do not replace it with new fake blur panels.
Keep LiveContainer guest launch, app isolation and LiveProcess runtime execution engine.
Keep embedded SideStore application services, authentication and device operations via documented adapters.
Keep SideSign signing/authentication library and key handling, no invented replacement.

independent_ui: overall information architecture and SwiftUI shell
home and app list presentation and local filtering
settings layouts, control sizes and navigational routing
pairing/Apple sign-in/2FA and signing status presentations
non-glass dialogs, notices, diagnostics and contextual error recovery
window manager action layout, size, touch targets and visual hierarchy without rewriting preserved Liquid Glass effect
responsive portrait/landscape-safe layout and dynamic type

architecture.ownership: UI depends on action ports and structured snapshots; engines never depend on UI
architecture.settings: Local state and actions cannot be blocked by SideStore connectivity
architecture.sideStore: Service-backed control must state service/authorization/permission preconditions
architecture.mutations: Do not claim success until authoritative result; no auto replay after unknown install/sign result
architecture.auth: One session owner; pairing, Apple authentication, 2FA, provisioning and installation are distinct states
architecture.guestRuntime: Use one existing LiveProcess control route; no duplicate Direct button paths
architecture.glass: Existing Liquid Glass renderer/effect stays outside new UI code behind injected host adapter

release_gates: Figma screen layers editable with screen parity coverage
pure Swift6 action coordinator behavioral tests pass
host shell wired to LiveContainer and SideStore/SideSign adapters
settings actions actually observed on iPhone
native Liquid Glass code and gestures unchanged by checksum/diff
bundle identity, entitlements and App Groups verified
signed IPA actual upgrade install and data preservation
Apple sign-in 2FA, pairing, refresh and guest runtime verified on iPhone

navigation.bottom_tab_injection: Required host-provided existing interactive Liquid Glass bar, bound via Binding<Tab>; no synthetic glassEffect in clean UI
navigation.app_switcher_action: existing host overlay with recent apps and window management segmented controls
